action_window.text: On the 2023 day the run became a threat at 20% asked (about 3:18 PM): from there 9 in 10 days sink the bank. Past 25.5% asked (about 3:57 PM) it can't pay without selling underwater bonds. 3 plans act in time without acting on rumors that fizzle.
